programme.desc: S01 E05 Taking a look at strange crafts flying over power plants, airports and the Royal Palace in Sweden, a veteran with supposed UFO-related health issues and footage shown at a US congressional hearing.
programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Las Vegas UFOs and More A Florida man encounters an elusive Sasquatch; ghost hunters attempt to contact the spirit of a murder victim in Tennessee; a Las Vegas resident captures incredible footage of UFOs soaring through the skies.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S04 E12 — The Dead on the Hill Dig into chilling claims in the coal-mining town of Harlan, where a mysterious woman in white has appeared repeatedly; learn how dread has driven off some hard-boiled locals as the team tries to get to the bottom of these supernatural happenings.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Miami Sinking The coastal metropolis of Miami faces a triple threat of crumbling limestone bedrock, ferocious superstorms and relentless rising oceans.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: S02 E07 — Trapped Spirits Visiting spirits that remain tied to the places that meant the world to them; feeling eerie energy in a historic Missouri mansion; facing a spectral sea captain in Nova Scotia; discovering a well of supernatural energy in a northern California hotel.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Goldrush Trail Part 1 Following paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they begin their travels up British Columbia's famed gold rush trail to explore its history and its hauntings.
programme.title: History's Most Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Murdered Pharaoh & Ghostly Wine The fate of Pharaoh Ramses III has long been clouded by rumors of a family plot against him; scientists examine the tomb, uncovering evidence that supports these ancient suspicions.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Gettysburg Orphanage One of the most eerie places in the USA, the former Gettysburg orphanage; witnesses report disturbing experiences, the whispering voices of children in empty rooms and shadowy figures.
programme.title: Paranormal Evidence: You Can't Deny it

programme.desc: S03 E02 — When Ghosts Get Physical A poltergeist haunts Kristine McKee's new home and gets physical with her son; a friend's past life comes back to haunt Danielle Low with potentially life-threatening results; a paranormal entity attacks a woman, leaving her black and blue.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: Exploring video evidence and testimony of the existence and nature of UFOs.
programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Haunted by a Rock Legend and More Paranormal investigators get a chilling response from a dearly departed rock legend; a ghostly canine joins its former owner for a nighttime stroll; a man and his co-workers spot a gaggle of UFOs in the Louisiana bayou.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Deadly Crossbow (The Ryan Family Story) Brett Ryan paves a long road of deception. The serial-lying ex-con hides his bank-robbing past from his fiancé and misleads his family, before a late-night confession to his mother leads to a murder no one could have seen coming.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Tall Whites A young recruit encounters aliens in the Nevada desert in the 1960s; he claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S01 E03 Check out clues left behind by a Yorkshire man's alien encounter. Review photos of a UFO crash site in Australia, meet a Canadian man whose voice was controlled by unknown forces, and witness unexplained.

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Secrets of Abandoned Places From the ancient Babylonians to modern-day urban explorers, mankind has always been fascinated by abandoned places; discovering the allure that draws people to post-apocalyptic landscapes.
programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner
